results.title: Copahue Extremo
results.overview: This fascinating documentary follows a Chilean-Argentine team of scientists in their search for extremophiles—living organisms that inhabit the most inhospitable conditions on Earth—to understand how, after billions of years of evolution and environmental change, they continue to exist and thrive. The expedition not only traverses stunning, remote landscapes but also invites reflection on the major challenges facing humanity, from climate change to the search for life on other planets.

results.title: Pálpito
results.overview: A tarot reader becomes obsessed with the feeling that a terrible misfortune is going to happen and will do anything to prevent it.

results.title: Ellis Park
results.overview: Australian musician Warren Ellis guides us through his musical career and his wildlife sanctuary in Sumatra, where rescued trafficked animals are nursed back to health by conservationists.

results.title: Solomamma
results.overview: Edith is a curiosity-driven journalist and single mother. Solo parenting proves to be complicated, but when the identity of the man who donated the sperm that got her pregnant surfaces, she seeks him out under the false pretext of interviewing him about his company.

results.title: Hippo's Revenge
results.overview: A father and daughter prepare to open their Safari Rescue in England, featuring a mother hippo and her calf. But when a ruthless criminal plots to steal them under the cover of night, chaos erupts.

results.title: The Sunflower's Bloom
results.overview: A high school student, Mirasol finds herself drawn to her classmate Aries. She faces the consequences as she gives in to temptation.

results.title: (Im)Perfetta
results.overview: Elena is 19 years old, heartbroken, and full of uncertainty. She is struck by a profile she finds online, beautiful, seductive, and able to understand her.

results.title: Stephen
results.overview: A psychiatrist evaluating a self-confessed serial killer unravels a twisted web of trauma, deceit, and psychological manipulation—only to question if the killer is truly guilty or just another victim in a larger, darker game.

results.title: The Goldsmith's Secret
results.overview: In 1999, a goldsmith revisits his hometown, triggering memories of his summer love affair with a seamstress 25 years prior. Despite their age gap, he vows to rewrite their story but struggles to find her upon his return.

results.title: Zucchini
results.overview: Two girls from Austin are driven by one's brother to New Orleans, and make a movie along the way.

results.title: Tourist Family
results.overview: A quirky Sri Lankan family seeking a fresh start in India transforms a disconnected neighborhood into a vibrant community with their infectious love and kindness.

results.title: Escape Reality
results.overview: A scientists daughter uses a virtual reality to escape a worldwide apocalypse. They must decide which world means more to them all while hiding from feral creatures in the real world that are trying to kill them

results.title: Hitman 2
results.overview: After a successful first season, Webtoon "Assassin Jun" is about to begin it's second season. Out of ideas, Jun uses an anonymous email's plot in his Webtoon, only to see real-life terrorist attacks resembling the story unfold.

results.title: High Ground
results.overview: When a mysterious prisoner lands in jail, a border town sheriff faces the wrath of a brutal cartel.

results.title: Captain Sabertooth and the Countess of Grel
results.original_title: Kaptein Sabeltann og Grevinnen av Gral
results.overview: Set sail for an exciting pirate adventure when Captain Sabertooth and Raven fight against Sibylla and her terrifying dragon in a battle that can only be won by courage, friendship and rat soup!

results.title: Silent Zone
results.overview: In a zombie-ravaged world, a resourceful teen and her protector fight for survival, facing relentless dangers and testing the limits of hope and loyalty.

results.title: Retro
results.overview: A man with a violent past seeks a fresh start, but the life he left behind resurfaces, forcing him to face old conflicts and redefine his future.

results.title: El olvido
results.overview: Almudena receives news of her teacher's death. No one has heard from her in a long time. This leads her to investigate and rethink her life.
